title: 深夜实验室，魔鬼导师撕了我的论文
style_en: Live-action, cinematic, cool blue-tinted night laboratory interior, shallow depth of field, in a vertical 9:16 frame

clips.location_en: a biological nanotechnology laboratory at two in the morning, lit only by the faint blue glow of a super-resolution microscope and its monitor

shots.action_en: she sits working at the super-resolution microscope when a stack of printed A4 reports is flung hard onto the bench beside her and scatters across the floor; she stands, then crouches and silently picks up the pages one by one, a worn notebook covered in handwritten formulas lying beside her
shots.camera_en: pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her trembling hands

dialogue.speaker: gu
dialogue.text_zh: 重做。连这种低级误差都查不出，你凭什么进我的组？

shots.sfx_en: sheets of paper slap against the tile floor

shots.action_en: a slender pale male hand presses down on the last sheet of paper before she can reach it
shots.camera_en: tilts up with large amplitude at slow speed, revealing him looking down at her with a cold, composed expression
shots.sfx_en: a single slow footstep lands on the tile

shots.action_en: he bends down close to her ear while she keeps her head lowered and her shoulders stiffen

dialogue.speaker: gu
dialogue.text_zh: 委屈了？晚上就偷偷用我的专属权限？

clips.soundscape_en: Sheets of paper flutter and slap against a hard laboratory floor while a low, steady hum from the microscope cooling fans and refrigerators fills the room, with a faint electrical buzz from a fluorescent tube.
clips.music_en: Sparse, low piano notes at a very slow tempo over a sustained sub-bass drone, punctuated by one deep bass hit on the first cut.

clips.location_en: the same night laboratory, the blue microscope glow on their faces

shots.action_en: she lifts her head to meet his eyes, tears glinting behind her glasses but her gaze stubborn and unflinching
shots.camera_en: holds a static shot on her face

dialogue.speaker: shen
dialogue.text_zh: 顾教授，这不是低级误差。

shots.sfx_en: her uneven, held breathing is audible

shots.action_en: she opens the worn notebook and turns it toward him, pages dense with handwritten formulas and a circled curve
shots.camera_en: pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the notebook

dialogue.speaker: shen
dialogue.text_zh: 是室温荧光淬灭异常，我发现了新的靶向通路。

shots.action_en: his gaze rests on her lips for half a second, then he reaches down and takes the pen out of her hand
shots.sfx_en: the faint click of the pen

clips.soundscape_en: Low room tone from laboratory refrigerators and a microscope fan, soft page rustles, and her held breathing in the close-ups.
clips.music_en: The sub-bass drone continues under sparse piano notes, with a single soft string swell that fades before the last shot.

clips.location_en: a white board beside a lab bench in the same night laboratory

shots.action_en: he plants one hand on the lab bench and turns to a whiteboard, writing three lines of kinetic equations in fast, sharp strokes
shots.camera_en: trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed following his hand
shots.sfx_en: the marker squeaks against the whiteboard

shots.action_en: she stares at the equations, lips parting slightly as the tears on her cheek dry
he caps the marker and turns to face her, standing close
shots.camera_en: pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed

dialogue.speaker: gu
dialogue.text_zh: 沈听澜，别拿这些小打小闹交差。

clips.soundscape_en: Marker squeaks on the whiteboard, the low hum of laboratory equipment, and a chair creaking once.
clips.music_en: A slow heartbeat-like kick-drum pulse enters under the piano and gradually increases in volume.

clips.location_en: the same night laboratory, a glass door with a card reader glowing red at the back

shots.action_en: he looks down at her, voice low and unhurried

dialogue.speaker: gu
dialogue.text_zh: 既然有野心，就把目标定在《Nature》封面。

shots.action_en: she freezes, eyes wide behind her glasses
he turns, swipes a card on the reader and the glass door of the top-tier instrument room unlocks with a soft click, then he glances back over his shoulder with one eyebrow raised
shots.camera_en: tracks him with small amplitude at slow speed

dialogue.speaker: gu
dialogue.text_zh: 今晚，我亲自做你的一助。

shots.sfx_en: the card reader beeps and the door lock clicks open

clips.soundscape_en: A card reader beep and a magnetic lock clicking open, the hiss of the glass door, and the steady equipment hum.
clips.music_en: The heartbeat pulse continues with a low string drone, dynamics rising slightly toward the end.

clips.location_en: the instrument room, a pipette and sample rack on a steel bench under a cool white lamp

shots.action_en: her hand holds a pipette over a sample rack, slightly unsteady
shots.camera_en: pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.sfx_en: the tiny click of the pipette

shots.action_en: his hand closes over hers on the pipette, fingertips warm against her skin, and her breath catches as she glances up
her face in profile, lips parted, the moment frozen as she looks at him

clips.soundscape_en: Near silence with a faint lamp hum, one pipette click, and a single caught breath.
clips.music_en: The heartbeat pulse and a rising sub-bass swell stop abruptly on the final shot, leaving silence.

ending_hook_zh: 顾辞渊俯身握住沈听澜握着移液枪的手，指尖温热相触，她心跳漏了半拍。

gu.appearance_en: a tall Chinese man of about 31 with a mature, composed, commanding presence, sharp clean jawline, clear cool-toned skin with no shine and no stubble, neatly groomed short black hair, cold steady eyes, in a well-fitted dark grey shirt with the collar open and sleeves rolled once, no jacket
gu.voice_en: a low, cold, unhurried voice with quiet authority
gu.speaker: S1
